lessons.advice: When debugging presentation MathML for scripted symbol names, inspect the emitted XML tree and distinguish it from content MathML. Check browser rendering separately; changing a serializer tree does not by itself prove the reported browser symptom is fixed.

assumptions.statement: In the original presentation printer, a symbol with subscripts and no superscripts is returned as an mi node containing an msub child.

scope.inputs: split_super_sub yields no supers and at least one sub

assumptions.statement: The original recorded serialization of Symbol("x2")**3 includes <mi><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>2</mi></msub></mi> inside the power base.
